label: EPC1::PHF1

sections.text: EPC1 encodes a chromatin-regulatory component of histone acetyltransferase complexes.
PHF1 encodes a Polycomb-associated histone reader involved in chromatin repression.

The fusion joins a transcriptional/chromatin-regulatory partner to PHF1 and alters Polycomb-associated regulatory architecture. EPC1::PHF1 is a recurrent alteration in low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma.
